grade_reason: No statement by him about AI since 1 January 2025 was found in news coverage or on his official site. The only AI mention on his site is a 2023 defense bill release that notes more funding for AI, which is before the period this project covers.
notes: All eight web searches ran (six required plus two extra: one on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act cosponsors and one on his name with Nevada). Name collision warning: nearly every result for 'Amodei' with AI terms is about Dario Amodei, the Anthropic chief executive, not this representative; none of those were attributed to him. The Hill article 'flood calls AI safeguards' (https://thehill.com/policy/technology/6086989-flood-calls-ai-safeguards/amp/) was opened and mentions only Dario Amodei. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, introduced 24 September 2026): the FastDemocracy page (https://fastdemocracy.com/bill-search/us/119/bills/USB00108512/) lists 12 cosponsors, all Democrats, and he is not among them; Congress.gov was not checked. The site search of amodei.house.gov found a 2023 National Defense Authorization Act release mentioning AI funding (out of period) and nothing about AI risk. From the earlier attempt (not repeated this run): his news release listing (30 releases, 25 February 2025 to 14 July 2026), the RSS feed and 'In the News' page were opened and none mentioned AI; those pages were read through a summarizing fetch tool, so a passing mention could have been missed. He announced his retirement on 6 February 2026 and leaves the House on 3 January 2027. Hearing remarks as Homeland Security appropriations subcommittee chairman were not checked individually. The many-signer August and September 2026 House letters were not searched, per instructions.
